definitions.gloss: fiercely; furiously; with great force or intensity
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with fierce intensity, violent energy, or unstoppable force. Often used with と as {猛然|もうぜん}と.

examples.japanese: {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
{猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}した→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}→侵入者：19521_shinnyuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}びかかった。
examples.english: The dog leaped at the intruder with fierce intensity.

notes:
Composed of {猛|もう} (fierce, ferocious) + {然|ぜん} (in such a manner). Almost always used in the form {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧, with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ marking it as an adverb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to stand up against fiercely
- {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反論|はんろん}する→反論する：17280_hanronsuru⟧: to argue back furiously
- {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run furiously
- {猛然|もうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{襲|おそ}いかかる: to attack ferociously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: intensely, violently — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: fiercely, intensely — similar intensity but used as a na-adjective stem
- ⟦{果敢|かかん}→果敢：07934_kakan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: boldly, daringly — emphasizes courage rather than raw force
